name: Brand Personality Appeal (BPA) Model
diagnostic: Is our brand personality distinct enough to be recognized, favorable enough to drive preference, and clear enough to prevent internal misinterpretation?
artifact: A three-factor audit: Personality Favorability, Personality Originality, Personality Clarity.
trap: Chasing originality that fails favorability: eccentricities added for novelty raise friction at adoption.

origin.line: Traci H. Freling, Jody L. Crosno & David H. Henard (2011)

pedigreeFull: Traci H. Freling, Jody L. Crosno, & David H. Henard (Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science, 2011). An academic model assessing the structural efficacy of a brand personality on consumer behavior.
artifactFull: A BPA Commercial Resonance Audit measuring three empirical factors: Personality Favorability (net positive sentiment impact), Personality Originality (differentiation from category baselines), and Personality Clarity (consistency of external perception).
trapFull: Pursuing an original brand personality that fails the favorability test—introducing eccentricities purely for novelty that add friction to buyer adoption.
